selected_public_operations.classify: classify(Ancestor,Raw) retains FINITE including zero, UNLIMITED, NO_LOCAL_INTERFACE and UNAVAILABLE. This public structured-observation operation also accepts externally supplied authoritative host observations.
selected_public_operations.evaluate: evaluate(long,List<Reading>,Visibility) computes exact BigInteger headroom and clamps to supplied signed-long host bound; availableBytes is null for unknown hierarchy visibility or any unusable required observation.
selected_public_operations.authority: COMPLETE_BY_AUTHORITY and NO_LIMIT_BY_AUTHORITY are trusted caller assertions, not values discovered or inferred by this reader. Setup must establish them from a host owner with visibility through every constraining ancestor and a matching libcgroup namespace/mount mapping. Chain shape is checked but cannot establish that authority.
selected_public_operations.no_local_interface: No memory controller or both missing-value statuses in a successful native snapshot. This records absence from that readable snapshot, not proof that no hidden or unreadable constraint exists. It remains unusable for LIMIT_REQUIRED; ignore it only under separately established NO_LIMIT_BY_AUTHORITY.
